title: Both fixed bases and copied reversed corners: conditional κ = 3.918734894e-5 > 2^-15
body:
**Ready for review:** the full rerun passed — 203 tests, exhaustive checks of all 4,073,300 source pairs, fresh producer audits, and 18 historical patch checks. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/copied-both-reversed/research/copied-both-reversed/validation.json).

Under the retained analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

**T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1 − κ)), with κ = 1959367447/50000000000000 = 3.918734894 × 10⁻⁵ > 2⁻¹⁵.**

This fixes both local bases to I+J in PR #39's copied reversed (23,25) construction. The complete original-envelope h23 profile replaces the remaining generic first-axis profile, preserving the actual **21+17+481 data blocks with nine singletons**. The conditional exponent saving is **0.8248% above PR #39** (`70ae24129649f6d6d4ec6360962a80c3c42a38f1`, κ=3.886675852e-5). No practical runtime or global optimality claim is made.

### Complete geometric proof gate

Every one of **4,073,300 actual source-triple pairs** passed all47 required ordered-prefix nonvanishing checks: **191,445,100 prefixes** total. Ten primary-prime zero events were resolved by restarting each whole pair at a second admissible prime. Independent Python elimination checked all ten failures and their successful fallback replays; one was also checked over exact rationals. No failed pair was discarded. Modular zeros are not treated as rational zeros.

The proof of universal ordered zeros remains the inherited all-weight rank-cut argument; the1,409,361,800 modular zero checks are regression evidence. Both bases are fixed, so no generic first-basis assumption is used. All4,071 individual source lines and48 copied-center complements have nonzero local scaling coordinates, and actual controlled-permutation restrictions transfer both complete local profiles. Both restriction trees and all physical contiguous data intervals remain.

### Exact costs and arithmetic

Fresh h23 BASE-TWO scalar/original matching/positive label reconstruction and independent audits pass. Its71,547 profiled matrices use five certified primes with rigorous integer-minor bounds; the inherited h25 profile has96,273 such matrices. Exactly23 h23 identity cleanup calls become23 rank-one complements, while every actual rank22 copied transform remains charged. The h25 copied profile is unchanged. The complete27-width child list retains all4,073,300 endpoint corrections and total rank108,202,762,275.

Bit saving is783777693/20000000000000. Exact rational moment gap exceeds8.1350e-16; final absorption gap exceeds1.3850e-15. The complex construction remains PR #36's (28,28), mixed-center19, saving717/10^7. Both moments, all47 strict assembly conditions, seven margins, semantic envelope including scalarG, C1=1, row stock p^2000 and eventual cutoffs pass. Eleven focused controls cover source/profile corruption, loss of the17-block at unchanged rank, copied-center accounting, unlucky primes and CRT reconstruction. A rigorous lower bound excludes the next bit grid point for this same profile only.

### Validation status

**Full inherited `make verify` passed** at research commit `43f59ff533598762cbc43a5e14af2bbbc76fabbd`: **203 tests**, a fresh full4,073,300pair geometry replay, all new and inherited producer/profile/label checks, and **18 historical patch checks**. The eleven focused tests also pass. Log SHA-256: `cdc7eda8e221dc11c50f5acd21aa7b229f1969fb70f2813b91c8106cf049e8c6`. Only documentation,validation receipt,source manifest and focused patch change after this tested research commit. Complete finite geometry, fresh portable h23 producer replay, exact arithmetic and independent agent proof audits pass before filing. These support the written conditional argument; they are not formal verification or external mathematical acceptance. Analytic recovery, fixed-tape routing/bulk interfaces, prime existence, constructive setup and eventual-threshold assumptions remain explicit.

Start with [proof and reproduction](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/copied-both-reversed/research/copied-both-reversed/README.md). Run `make copied-both-reversed-check`, `make copied-both-reversed-producer`, then `make verify`. The full geometry replay checks all pairs. The focused patch applies to pinned PR #39; no sibling checkout is needed.
